By incorporating the name Het in one's identity, one is connecting to this powerful and positive cultural heritage. historical_references.reference: The name Het is mentioned in the Rigveda, one of the oldest Hindu scriptures. It is the name of a horse sacrificed by Indra in a great battle against the demon Vritra. The horse Het is described as having ten eyes and is said to have helped Indra in his victory over Vritra.

The name Het is also mentioned in the Mahabharata, an epic Sanskrit text. In this context, Het is the name of a king of the Vidarbha region who played an important role in the great battle of Kurukshetra between the Pandava and Kaurava armies. Het sided with the Pandavas and was killed in the battle by Bhishma Pitamaha.
